# Website motion system

Status: canonical `1.0.0` through `H-EXP-07-CHANNEL-MOTION-PROOF` and `DEC-WEBSITE-MOTION-SYSTEM-001`.

Round 03 closed EXP-07 with seven approved specimens: three motion laws plus section entry, accordion/tabs, a user-driven carousel and processor/progress. Static remains complete, one expressive event may run in the viewport, controls respond briefly to user intent, carousels never autoplay, scroll is never hijacked and reduced motion preserves the same meaning.

`MOT-W02` is deliberately deferred rather than approved or killed. A real global navigation owns visual direction, semantics, responsive behaviour, focus management, destinations, product allocation and packaging. That work continues later under `TASK-CMP-01-GLOBAL-NAVIGATION`, using the dependency-free `<mez-explore-menu>` in `explore-menu/` as research evidence—not as current canonical code.

Email, paid advertising, organic social, film, Figma animation and motion-graphics production remain outside this system. Documents, compact identity and open graph remain static outputs.

Build and verify:

```bash
.venv/bin/python brand-kit/expressions/channel-motion/build_channel_motion_candidate.py
.venv/bin/python brand-kit/expressions/channel-motion/verify_channel_motion_candidate.py
```

Locked proof:

`/brand-kit/workbench/expressions/channel-motion/`
